curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with why New Jersey phases in privileges, then walk Option A from the special learner permit at sixteen: consent, the instructor buying the permit, the six-hour dual-control course, and validation before any practice.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards that keep the two-year permit validity apart from the two-year test results and keep Option A the only instructor-bought road.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on GDL purpose, Option A entry steps and permit validation.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Follow Option A through six months and fifty supervised hours, the Certification of Supervised Driving, the probationary license at seventeen, a year of probation, and the Licensing Center upgrade.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; a contrast card that separates the end of probation from the upgrade visit that actually lifts the restrictions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps practice lengths, ages and the upgrade step.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare Option B at seventeen and Option C at twenty-one with Option A: the examination permit without an instructor, the practice each road asks for, and how long test results stay good.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per road step; contrast cards for special learner versus examination permit and for three months versus six months of practice.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the roads' starting ages and practice requirements.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the late-night driving ban and its narrow work or religion exemption, the total electronic device ban, who may supervise, shared responsibility for offenses, and the penalty for ignoring restrictions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per restriction; contrast cards for the prohibited hours versus the letterhead exemption.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on hours, devices, supervisors and penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the passenger limits of the special learner permit from the examination permit and probationary license, then seat belts, decal placement and cost, and exactly what lifts at twenty-one.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the two passenger limits and for what the age twenty-one footnote does and does not lift.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps passenger limits, decal placement and the age twenty-one lifts.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the examination permit every out-of-state driver needs, the sixty-day window, GDL for newcomers under eighteen, which tests are waived, and why an International Driving Permit never replaces a license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for the International Driving Permit versus a driver license.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on newcomer deadlines, waived tests and the IDP.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the non-driver ID from fourteen, the organ donor question and registry, Sara's Law emergency contacts, voter registration at motor vehicle offices, and the hearing-impaired license code.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per registry or designation; a contrast card for the organ donor wording versus the hearing-impaired numerical code.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who may join each registry and what each one does.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Introduce the three commercial classes and the basic license they require, the weight and passenger lines between Classes A, B and C, who needs no CDL, the P, S, H and N endorsements, and restriction L.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per class or endorsement; contrast cards for Class A versus Class B and for an endorsement versus a restriction.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps class lines, endorsement requirements and restriction L.
